# Project Showcase

This is the portfolio and project showcase of Monojit. It features a curated collection of web development projects, ranging from sleek web apps to creative experiments.

## Pages
- Home (https://example.com/): The main portfolio page featuring the projects grid, stats, and contact links.

## Featured Projects
- Blog Gen: An AI-powered platform that automatically generates engaging, high-quality blog posts.
- Zenith E-Commerce: A modern storefront with AI-powered recommendations, seamless checkout, and inventory management.
- Aether Portfolio: Minimal creative portfolio with smooth scroll animations, project galleries, and a contact form.

## Technology Stack
The site is built with HTML, CSS (Custom Properties, Flexbox, CSS Grid, Animations), and Vanilla JavaScript. It uses a modern Teal and Emerald aesthetic with pill-shaped components and a responsive design.
